candidate_coverage: Read all 217 titles and summaries in six context batches through offset 200 and next_offset=null. cards.analysis: The deficit follows the absolute figures even when the export growth rate is higher. The next release can show whether both movements persist.

cards.novelty: The accepted September trade entry showed a narrowing gap. October is a fresh measured period with a widening gap.

catalysts: The IMD title gives the Andhra direction and its summary dates severe intensification by November 17 evening. The November 16 formation forecast describes a different intensity milestone of the same system. The November 16 Manila travel date anchors the two summits to November 17. Both dated, distinct events fit in the single closing module. The FAA audit already began, and the PFC record date is shareholder administration.
hero: The hero covers all seven cards and retains status: a reported trade gap, a priced offer, a plant plan, an audit underway, a bill pending tabling, proposed SEBI safeguards and completed seed financing.
